plain: A person who lives near a frontier.

webster.text: One who dwells on a border, or at the extreme part or confines of a country, region or tract of land; one who dwells near to a place.

example.quote: It is proved by his favorite Roman history, that republican borderers are as apt to have rancor in their hearts as any.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
